:::{#sol-held-out-unbiased}

Given $\trainset$, the rule $\fitted$ is fixed.
Each held-out pair has the same distribution as $(X_0, Y_0)$
and is independent of $\trainset$,
so each squared prediction error has conditional expectation
$\E{\sqf{\fitted(X_{0,j}) - Y_{0,j}} \mid \trainset} = \generr_{\trainset}$
by @eq-generalization-error.
Then

$$
\ba
& \E{\frac{1}{m} \sum_{j=1}^m \sqf{\fitted(X_{0,j}) - Y_{0,j}} \mid \trainset}
\\
&\quad = \frac{1}{m} \E{\sum_{j=1}^m \sqf{\fitted(X_{0,j}) - Y_{0,j}} \mid \trainset}
&& \text{(constant } 1/m \text{ out)}
\\
&\quad = \frac{1}{m} \sum_{j=1}^m \E{\sqf{\fitted(X_{0,j}) - Y_{0,j}} \mid \trainset}
&& \text{(linearity of } \Ep \text{)}
\\
&\quad = \frac{1}{m} \sum_{j=1}^m \generr_{\trainset}
&& \text{(each term, as above)}
\\
&\quad = \frac{1}{m} \paren{m \, \generr_{\trainset}}
&& \text{(} m \text{ equal terms)}
\\
&\quad = \paren{\frac{1}{m} \cdot m} \generr_{\trainset}
&& \text{(regroup the product)}
\\
&\quad = 1 \cdot \generr_{\trainset}
&& (\tfrac{1}{m} \cdot m = 1)
\\
&\quad = \generr_{\trainset}
&& (1 \cdot b = b)
\ea
$$

The step labeled "each term, as above" is the one that needs the held-out set
to be independent of $\trainset$.

:::
